summary: Linear search for the value a2 in an array of stride-160 elements rooted at this[3] (offset 0xC) with this[4] (offset 0x10) entries. Returns the zero-based matching index, or -1 when the element is absent or the array is empty. Each step compares the current element pointer (advanced by 160 bytes) against a2.

operations.description: Read the entry count this[4] (offset 0x10) into v2 and initialize the search index v4 to 0 and the default result to -1.
Guard on this[4] > 0; when the array is empty or has a negative count, skip the loop and return -1.
Iterate a pointer i starting at this[3] (offset 0xC) and advancing by 160 bytes each step, comparing i against a2.
Before each comparison, increment v4 and return -1 when v4 reaches the entry count v2, i.e. the element was not found.
Return the matching index v4 when the search pointer equals a2.
Return -1 when the array is empty or the element is absent.
Invoked by LookupWithOptionalCallback (0x0040B450) to resolve an element index by pointer.

unresolved: The stride-160 element layout and the type of a2 (pointer vs. value) are not recoverable from this function alone.
The identity of the owning object and the meaning of the returned index depend on the caller at 0x0040B450.
